heading: Article 83 General conditions for imposing administrative fines
old_text: Infringements shall be subject to administrative fines up to EUR 10 000 000, or up to 2 % of the total worldwide annual turnover.
new_text: Infringements shall be subject to administrative fines up to EUR 40 000 000, or up to 8 % of the total worldwide annual turnover.

heading: Article 33 Notification of a breach
old_text: The controller shall notify the breach to the supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it.
new_text: The controller shall notify the breach to the supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 24 hours after having become aware of it.

heading: Article 12 Transparent information
old_text: The information shall be provided in writing, or by other means, including, where appropriate, by electronic means.
new_text: The information shall be provided in writing or by other means, including, where appropriate, by electronic means.

heading: Article 40 Codes of conduct
old_text: Associations representing categories of controllers may prepare codes of conduct.
new_text: Associations representing categories of controllers may prepare codes of conduct. Micro, small and medium-sized enterprises shall be exempt from the obligation to keep records under Article 30.
